question: What kinds of devotion must be absent in those deemed unfit recipients?
premises: A person may lack devotion to the kula
A person may lack devotion to the guru
Such absence marks unfitness in this context
inference: Those devoid of devotion to the kula and to the guru are unfit recipients.
plain_english: Indeed, in one who is devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru.
